Step-by-step tutorials for learning Rflow. ***In development***. More tutorials will be added over time.

::: {.clickable-feature-grid}
::: {.clickable-feature-card}
<a href="tutorial_1a.qmd" class="card-link">
  <h3>Tutorial 1A: Basics of Rflow</h3>
  
  This tutorial shows you how to create a simple Rflow workflow, import data, display summary tables and visualisations of your data, and save your workflow.
  </a>
:::

::: {.clickable-feature-card}
<a href="tutorial_1b.qmd" class="card-link">
  <h3>Tutorial 1B: Simple visualisation</h3>

  This tutorial introduces you to a range of simple visualisation techniques, including scatterplots, line plots, and bar charts.
  </a>
:::

::: {.clickable-feature-card}
<a href="tutorial_1c.qmd" class="card-link">
  <h3>Tutorial 1C: Bar charts with error bars</h3>
  
  Producing bar charts with error bars is a common task in many environmental and biological datasets. This tutorial shows you how to do this in Rflow.
</a>

:::

::: {.clickable-feature-card}
<a href="tutorial_2.qmd" class="card-link">
  <h3>Tutorial 2: Introduction to linear models</h3>

  This tutorial covers the basics of linear models, including simple and multiple regression. It shows you how to interpret the results of these models and check their validity.
</a>
:::
